changes.ja: 元の DICOM から片足分を切り出して面内を半分に縮小、骨ラベルを解析領域に変換して骨の名称ラベルを付与、本アプリで3D再構成
changes.en: cropped to one hindpaw and downsampled in-plane by half from the original DICOM; bone labels converted to analysis regions with a name label for each bone; 3D reconstruction and rendering in this app
